title: chinaBizInfo
description: This object contains information that is required if the customer plans to deploy to PoPs in mainland China.

category.description:
The category indicates the type of customer:
CategoryDescription
1military
2government
3insititution
4business
5person
6social group
999others

idType.description:
The idType field indicates a type of ID for the customer. Its value must be specified in the idNumber field.
idType Description
1business license number
2ID card
3license of organization code
4certificate of business corporation
5army code
6social group legal person certificate
7passport
8military ID
9mainland travel permit for Taiwan residents
999others

idNumber.description: An ID number corresponding to the idType that was specified. For example, if idType is 'passport', the idNumber field should be set to the passport number.
